definitions.gloss: to be blown away, to be swept away (by wind or force)
definitions.explanation: To be physically blown away or scattered by wind, an explosion, or other powerful force.
Used figuratively to describe negative feelings, worries, or fatigue disappearing suddenly and completely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: My hat was blown away by the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: The roof was blown off by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: The building's windows were blown out by the explosion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: My drowsiness vanished in an instant.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: When I saw my child's smile, my fatigue was swept away.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧で、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すべて{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: With that one remark, all my previous anxiety was swept away.

notes:
Godan verb (ぶ row: {吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ぶ → {吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ばない → {吹|ふ}き{飛|と}んで). A compound of ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow) + ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly). The transitive counterpart is ⟦{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ばす→吹き飛ばす：04617_fukitobasu⟧ (to blow something away).

The figurative usage (sense 2) is very common in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ぶ — to be blown away by the wind
- ⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ぶ — drowsiness vanishes
- ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ぶ — fatigue is swept away
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ぶ — anxiety vanishes
